summary: Fourteen regular-season games were played on Wednesday, and two went to overtime. Victor Wembanyama scored a night-high 52 in San Antonio's 112-111 win over Dallas, and Miami beat the Clippers 117-116 in overtime on Klay Thompson's three-pointer with 1 second left. New York had the largest margin, beating Chicago 135-105.

games.headline: Brown and Embiid lead 76ers past Pistons 112-106
games.story: Philadelphia led by as many as 18 and was up 56-42 at halftime. It led 91-75 after three quarters, and Detroit won the fourth 31-21 but stayed behind. Jaylen Brown scored 30 on 11-of-19 shooting and Joel Embiid had 26 points and 15 rebounds, going 10 of 10 at the line. Duncan Robinson hit seven threes for 27 points and Cade Cunningham had 26 points and 11 assists for Detroit, which was without Jalen Duren.

games.headline: Hawks hit 19 threes in 120-105 win over Wizards
games.story: Atlanta scored 37 in the first quarter and led from 27-25 late in the period. The Hawks were up 68-61 at halftime and by as many as 16. They made 19 of 49 three-pointers to Washington's 6 of 26. Nickeil Alexander-Walker scored 26 for Atlanta, and Anthony Davis had 26 points and 10 rebounds for Washington.

games.headline: Celtics hold off Bucks 109-102 after 22-point lead
games.story: Boston led 28-14 after one quarter, 62-41 at halftime and by as many as 22. Milwaukee won the third quarter 38-25 to cut it to 87-79, and Boston went ahead for good at 99-97 with 3:06 left. Paul George scored 25 with five threes and Derrick White had 24, going 9 of 9 at the line, while Boston was without Jayson Tatum. Tyler Herro led Milwaukee with 25.

games.headline: Nets pull away in fourth to beat Hornets 114-104
games.story: Charlotte led 57-50 at halftime, and the teams were tied at 80 after three quarters. Brooklyn took the lead for good at 86-83 with 10:22 left and won the fourth quarter 34-24. Michael Porter Jr. scored 26 with 10 rebounds and Julius Randle added 22. Naz Reid led Charlotte with 28 points on 11-of-18 shooting.

games.headline: Knicks rout Bulls 135-105 behind Brunson's 33
games.story: New York scored 43 in the first quarter and led 84-52 at halftime. The lead reached 44 in the third quarter, at 111-67. Jalen Brunson scored 33 on 10-of-17 shooting and Karl-Anthony Towns had 17 points and 12 rebounds, making all five of his shots. Chicago never led by more than 2, and Tre Jones and Jaylin Sellers topped the Bulls with 14 each.

games.headline: Nembhard scores 22 as Pacers edge Grizzlies 107-103
games.story: The lead changed hands 16 times, and the teams were tied nine times. Indiana led 54-52 at halftime, Memphis led 82-80 after three quarters, and the Pacers went ahead for good at 92-91 with 4:47 left. Memphis cut it to 104-103 with 28 seconds left, and Indiana scored the last three points. Andrew Nembhard led Indiana with 22 points, and Cedric Coward and Ty Jerome each scored 23 for Memphis.

games.headline: Pelicans beat Jazz 120-113 in OT despite George's 39
games.story: Utah scored 43 in the third quarter to lead 80-70, but New Orleans won the fourth 34-24 to tie it at 104 in regulation. In overtime the Pelicans outscored the Jazz 16-9 and went ahead for good at 111-110 with 1:55 left. Keyonte George scored 39 for Utah with nine assists. Zion Williamson scored 23 and Saddiq Bey 22 for New Orleans, and Dejounte Murray went 11 of 11 at the line.

games.headline: Gilgeous-Alexander scores 42 as Thunder top Cavaliers
games.story: Oklahoma City scored the first points and never trailed. It led 60-44 at halftime and by as many as 25. Cleveland won the fourth quarter 42-36 but lost 124-116. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scored 42 points, making 15 of 19 free throws, and Ajay Mitchell added 23. Donovan Mitchell led Cleveland with 27, and the Thunder were without Chet Holmgren and Jalen Williams.

games.headline: Timberwolves outscore Rockets 35-23 in fourth, win 117-107
games.story: The teams were tied 57-57 at halftime and traded the lead 26 times. Houston led 84-82 after three quarters, and Minnesota went ahead for good at 99-96 with 6:04 left. Ayo Dosunmu scored 21, LaMelo Ball 20 and Bones Hyland 19 for the Timberwolves, who were without Anthony Edwards. Kevin Durant scored 21 for Houston, and Alperen Sengun had 17 points, 12 rebounds and 10 assists.

games.headline: Nuggets win 128-109 on 41-15 third quarter vs Raptors
games.story: Toronto led 67-64 at halftime, then Denver outscored it 41-15 in the third quarter. The Nuggets went ahead for good at 70-69 with 10:29 left in that period, led 105-82 after three and by as many as 27. Nikola Jokic had 32 points, 10 rebounds and 11 assists on 13-of-19 shooting. RJ Barrett led Toronto with 22.

games.headline: Trail Blazers beat Suns 132-119 on a 43-point second
games.story: Portland went ahead for good at 40-39 early in the second quarter and outscored Phoenix 43-25 in it to lead 72-59 at halftime. The lead reached 22, and it was 104-85 entering the fourth. Damian Lillard scored 25, Donovan Clingan had 24 points and 11 rebounds, and Deni Avdija had 21 points and 12 assists. Devin Booker scored 33 for Phoenix, making all 13 of his free throws.

games.headline: Wembanyama's 52 lead Spurs past Mavericks 112-111
games.story: San Antonio led 68-51 at halftime and by as many as 19, but Dallas won the fourth quarter 31-22 and tied it at 111 with 1:41 left. Victor Wembanyama's free throw with 24 seconds left made it 112-111, the last points of the game. He finished with 52 points, 24 rebounds and 8 blocks, making 19 of 23 free throws. Kyrie Irving led Dallas with 29.

games.headline: Dončić scores 40 as Lakers beat Kings 116-103
games.story: Los Angeles went ahead for good at 48-46 late in the second quarter and led 61-54 at halftime. It was up 87-74 after three and by as many as 18. Luka Dončić scored 40 points with six threes, 9 rebounds and 7 assists, and Austin Reaves added 21. Darius Acuff Jr. had 22 points and 12 assists for Sacramento, and Domantas Sabonis had 16 points and 17 rebounds.

games.headline: Thompson's late 3 lifts Heat past Clippers 117-116 in OT
games.story: Los Angeles scored 43 in the second quarter, led 67-52 at halftime and by as many as 20. Miami won the fourth quarter 29-20 to tie it at 107 in regulation. The Clippers led 116-112 in overtime, but Miami scored the last five points, ending with Klay Thompson's three-pointer with 1 second left. Bam Adebayo scored 35 and Thompson 30 with eight threes, while Darius Garland led Los Angeles with 26.
